            eeg = np.concatenate([eeg.values, pad], axis=0)
        else:
            eeg = eeg.values[:10000]

        eeg = (eeg - eeg.mean(axis=0)) / (eeg.std(axis=0) + 1e-8)
        eeg = torch.tensor(eeg.T, dtype=torch.float32)

# Model definition remains unchanged
class ResNetBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_sizes=[3, 7, 11]):
        super().__init__()
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList()
        for ks in kernel_sizes:
            self.convs.append(
                nn.Sequential(
                    nn.Conv1d(in_channels, out_channels, ks, padding=ks // 2),
                    nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels),
                    nn.ReLU(),
                    nn.Conv1d(out_channels, out_channels, ks, padding=ks // 2),
                    nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels),
                )
            )
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Conv1d(in_channels, out_channels * len(kernel_sizes), 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels * len(kernel_sizes)
            else nn.Identity()
        )
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool1d(2)

    def forward(self, x):
        residuals = [conv(x) for conv in self.convs]
        out = torch.cat(residuals, dim=1)
        out += self.shortcut(x)
        out = F.relu(out)
        return self.pool(out)

        super().__init__()
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(
            ResNetBlock(in_channels, 32), ResNetBlock(96, 64), ResNetBlock(192, 128)
        )
        self.gap = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(384, num_classes)

        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="relu")

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.gap(x).squeeze(-1)
        return self.fc(x)
